headline: OCBC Reports Three Percent Rise in Third-Quarter Net Profit
summary: OCBC posted a 3% increase in third-quarter net profit to S$2.04 billion, slightly beating expectations. Non-interest income dipped due to weaker investment performance by its insurance arm, Great Eastern.
why: Quarterly earnings from major Southeast Asian financial institutions offer key benchmarks on regional banking health, wealth management fees, and insurance portfolio performance.
